name: Intrigue (2nd Edition) — Kingdom Cards
note: Official Intrigue 2E roster (26 cards). Sources: dominionstrategy wiki set page + per-card pages, cross-checked against card scans. Baron, Courtier, Diplomat, Lurker, Mill, Patrol, Replace, Secret Passage are the 2E additions; the 6 cut 1E cards (Secret Chamber, Great Hall, Coppersmith, Scout, Saboteur, Tribute) are absent.

cards.name: Baron
cards.text: +1 Buy; You may discard an Estate card. If you do, +$4. Otherwise, gain an Estate card.

cards.name: Bridge
cards.text: +1 Buy; +$1; All cards (including cards in players' hands) cost $1 less this turn, but not less than $0.

cards.name: Conspirator
cards.text: +$2; If you've played 3 or more Actions this turn (counting this): +1 Card; +1 Action.

cards.name: Courtier
cards.text: Reveal a card from your hand. For each type it has (Action, Attack, etc.), choose one: +1 Action; or +1 Buy; or +$3; or gain a Gold. The choices must be different.

cards.name: Courtyard
cards.text: +3 Cards; Put a card from your hand on top of your deck.

cards.name: Diplomat
cards.text: +2 Cards; If you have 5 or fewer cards in hand (after drawing), +2 Actions. Reaction: When another player plays an Attack card, you may reveal this from your hand. If you do, you draw 1 card and discard 1 card.

cards.name: Duke
cards.text: Worth 1 VP per Duchy you have.

cards.name: Harem
cards.text: +$2; Worth 2 VP.

cards.name: Ironworks
cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $4. If it is an… Action card, +1 Action. Treasure card, +$1. Victory card, +1 Card.

cards.name: Lurker
cards.text: +1 Action; Choose one: Trash an Action card from the Supply, or gain an Action card from the trash.

cards.name: Masquerade
cards.text: +2 Cards; Each player passes a card in their hand to the player on their left. You may trash a card from your hand.

cards.name: Mill
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; You may discard 2 cards, for +$2.

cards.name: Mining Village
cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions; You may trash this card immediately. If you do, +$2.

cards.name: Minion
cards.text: +1 Action; Choose one: +$2; or discard your hand, +4 Cards; and each other player with at least 5 cards in hand discards his hand and draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Nobles
cards.text: Choose one: +3 Cards; or +2 Actions.

cards.name: Patrol
cards.text: +3 Cards; Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Put the Victory cards and Curses into your hand. Put the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Pawn
cards.text: Choose two: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; +$1. (The choices must be different.)

cards.name: Replace
cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to $2 more than it. If the gained card is an Action or Treasure, put it onto your deck; if it's a Victory card, each other player gains a Curse.

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.text: +2 Cards; +1 Action; Take a card from your hand and put it anywhere in your deck.

cards.name: Shanty Town
cards.text: +2 Actions; Reveal your hand. If you have no Action cards in hand, +2 Cards.

cards.name: Steward
cards.text: Choose one: +2 Cards; or +$2; or trash 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Swindler
cards.text: +$2; Each other player trashes the top card of his deck and gains a card with the same cost that you choose.

cards.name: Torturer
cards.text: +3 Cards; Each other player chooses one: he discards 2 cards; or he gains a Curse card, putting it in his hand.

cards.name: Trading Post
cards.text: Trash 2 cards from your hand. If you do, gain a Silver; put it into your hand.

cards.name: Upgrade
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; Trash a card from your hand. Gain a card costing exactly $1 more than it.

cards.name: Wishing Well
cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; Name a card, then reveal the top card of your deck. If it is the named card, put it in your hand.
